name: eq_seminorms
statement: Type*} {α : outParam (Type*)} [Ring α] [FunLike F α ℝ] [RingSeminormClass F α ℝ] {f g : F} (hfpm : IsPowMul f) (hgpm : IsPowMul g) (hfg : ∃ (r : ℝ) (_ : 0 < r), ∀ a : α, f a ≤ r * g a) (hgf : ∃ (r : ℝ) (_ : 0 < r), ∀ a : α, g a ≤ r * f a) : f = g

name: eq_of_powMul_faithful
statement: AlgebraNorm R S) (hf₁_pm : IsPowMul f₁) (f₂ : AlgebraNorm R S) (hf₂_pm : IsPowMul f₂) (h_eq : ∀ y : S, ∃ (C₁ C₂ : ℝ) (_ : 0 < C₁) (_ : 0 < C₂), ∀ x : R[y], f₁ x.val ≤ C₁ * f₂ x.val ∧ f₂ x.val ≤ C₂ * f₁ x.val) : f₁ = f₂
